Weaker model likely stops at plain request import. Frontier hours estimate 6 for whole scope.

full_card.deliverable: New importer modules in the converters package that map external API-client formats to Bruno .bru collection model (auth, environments, scripts, tests). Format list still unpinned: only Thunder Client (#511) is traced upstream.

Vendoring @usebruno/converters from npm is blocked offline, but the snapshot's own converters are readable and would be a shortcut for three formats.

spike_plan.kill_if: Converter suite is red or does not run offline after install, or most new-format auth/script fields have several valid .bru mappings (so exact-text grading would penalise valid solutions).
spike_plan.pass_if: Converter suite runs green with per-test results in under ~15 minutes, existing converters cover at least 3 formats end-to-end, and at least 80% of the chosen new format's auth/env/script fields have a unique .bru mapping.
steps: In a throwaway container with network, clone usebruno/bruno at dd0281da into a fresh scratch directory (no history rewrite needed; it is a read-only probe).

Install dependencies for packages/bruno-converters only (npm ci at workspace scope, or a minimal install) and run its jest suite; record pass count, failures and wall time to answer whether the regression gate is green offline.
Read the postman and insomnia converters in src to see which of auth, environments, scripts and tests they already map to .bru; this sets the real remaining scope.
Pick one new format with a public schema (Thunder Client JSON export or Hoppscotch collection JSON) and list each field it has for auth, env, scripts, tests; mark each as unambiguous or subjective.
Convert the same input twice with a quick script and diff the .bru output to check determinism.
Count how many fields of the chosen format map unambiguously to the .bru model; this sets the grading surface.

v1.summary: The Bruno repo is real and MIT-licensed at a released tag, but the snapshot already ships bruno-converters with Postman, Insomnia, OpenAPI and WSDL importers, so the seed's import path is partly present and the format list is largely unverified beyond the open Thunder Client request. The seed's grading depends on expected .bru text that we author, so a different valid mapping would fail, which is a K4 kill; a redesigned scope using new formats with objective semantic comparison could be re-seeded after the spike.
